title: Memory Leak Investigation
description: Find out why the memory of the container is slowly filling up.
summary:
Added copy to clipboard (Ctrl+C) feature to all compose UI Design components (ComposeDiagram, ComposeDesign, PieceSelection, ConnectionSelection). Implemented a new 🔖Clipboard region with:

1. `buildDesignClipboardData` pure function with 4 modes:
   - No diff + no selection: copies the full design
   - No diff + selection present: copies only selected pieces and connections
   - Diff present + no selection: copies the full diff
   - Diff + selection present: copies only selected parts of the diff (filters added/removed/updated by guid)

2. `useDesignClipboard` hook that listens for Ctrl+C (or Cmd+C) keydown on a container element, computes clipboard data via `buildDesignClipboardData`, and writes serialized JSON to the clipboard. Respects native text selection (doesn't override when text is selected).

3. Wired into `ComposeDiagram` (via existing container ref) and `ComposeDesign` (via new ref). Both containers are now focusable (tabIndex=0). PieceSelection and ConnectionSelection inherit the behavior through ComposeDiagram.

4. Added 8 unit tests covering all 4 clipboard modes plus edge cases (empty selection, filtered updates).

All 148 tests pass.
